Dear America and anyone else who might be confused:

Here are four countries - England, Scotland (Alba), Wales (Cymru) and Ireland (Éire).

Great Britain (which is an island) is comprised of the first three of these countries.

The United Kingdom is Great Britain plus Northern Ireland (a constituent nation).

Northern Ireland and Ireland are parts of an island called Ireland.

All of the these countries are in Europe. However, only Ireland is in the European Union.
